caption:
ACA health plan prices are going up again for 2027. 🏥

KFF says the average benchmark premium rises about 13% next year, after a 26% jump this year.
Most people on the marketplace still get help paying, but the sticker price keeps climbing.

Have you compared plans yet this enrollment season?
